title: VIDEO: Pune Station Masters Protest, Demand Vacancies Be Filled

ai.summary: Station masters in Pune's railway division protested demanding recruitment for vacancies, an end to arbitrary transfers, and reinstatement of a station master after accusing the railway administration of dictatorial practices and staff shortages.

facts.claim: vacancies in the Pune Division had reached 28 to 30 per cent
facts.quote: vacancies in the Pune Division had reached 28 to 30 per cent

facts.claim: a single station master to handle responsibilities that were earlier shared by two employees
facts.quote: forcing a single station master to handle responsibilities that were earlier shared by two employees

facts.claim: the mounting workload was affecting employees’ health and compromising operational safety
facts.quote: the mounting workload was affecting employees’ health and compromising operational safety

facts.claim: the railway administration of adopting dictatorial practices and putting employees under undue pressure
facts.quote: accused the railway administration of adopting dictatorial practices and putting employees under undue pressure

ai.background_note: Station masters in Pune's railway division have been protesting for recruitment and better conditions after accusing the railway administration of dictatorial practices and staff shortages.
